source_grounded_key_points: 9 SYMMETRY Look around you — you may find many objects that catch your attention.
Some such things are shown below: Flower Butterfly Rangoli Pinwheel There is something beautiful about the pictures above.
In these pictures, it appears that some parts of the figure are repeated and these repetitions seem to occur in a definite pattern.
Can you see what repeats in the beautiful rangoli figure?
